scope: Opportunity Zone designation-stage bounded run: statutory authority, designation mechanics/timeline, one GAO oversight report, attempted QOF Form-D sample. Public sources, public roles only.
pricing_note: Costs are APPROXIMATE. The Agent tool exposes total subagent_tokens but not the input/output split; costs below assume a blended split (labeled). For the exact Tier-Bench ledger, harvest the input/output token split from the subagent transcripts named in each phase's harvest_pointer. Prices per models.json: haiku-4-5 $1.0/$5.0 per 1M in/out; sonnet-5 assumed $3.0/$15.0 per 1M in/out.

phases.success_criterion: produced structurally valid, verifiable receipts and honestly marked unreachable surfaces (did not fabricate)
phases.verification: 2 of 2 load-bearing receipts spot-checked by the top rung VERIFIED (GAO finding verbatim; tract count resolved). 3 surfaces honestly marked unavailable/not_searched.

phases.success_criterion: correct dedupe, correct OPEN determination on the positioning question, contradiction flagged, no fabricated facts, forbidden-inference boundary drawn
phases.verification: All resolution operations confirmed correct by the top rung; no hallucinated facts (0 web calls, worked only from retrieval output).

phases.tokens_note: main-loop tokens not separately instrumented in this harness; the top rung's work was deliberately minimal — 2 live checks + 1 gate.
phases.success_criterion: verified load-bearing receipts, resolved the flagged contradiction, promoted nothing (positioning question stays OPEN), gate held

cost_per_success.cheap_tier_note: Haiku (~$0.09) + Sonnet (~$0.35) produced the entire triaged, receipt-backed, honestly-scoped candidate set. The top rung touched only the one-cell-wide judgment residue (2 receipt checks, 1 contradiction, the forbidden-inference gate).
cost_per_success.tier_bench_reading: Live confirmation of H1 (commodity-markup) and the settled-vs-derived axis: retrieval + resolution are commodity work the cheap rungs did at parity; the expensive tier did only what retrieval may not do by contract — verify and decide.

outcome.next_pass: Wire the SEC Form-D (QOF) and county-recorder photonic adapters — exactly the acquisition cost the harness predicted — to reach fund-formation and pre-designation ownership dates.
